description: Manage player characters (PCs): create, import, stage, activate, edit, signal, remove, or list the roster. stage adds an existing entity to the roster; set_active chooses which Novel entity play acts through and optionally sets pov; import requires roster_id and copies that roster character into the Novel. sheet and roster_list are read-only; Novel mutations persist, are audited, and are undoable via manage_history (action: undo). update merges provided fields (stats shallow-merge; omitted preserved); personality{} aliases description/voice/background/goals; details{} aliases ability_scores/skills/feats/talents/equipment; a top-level value overrides its alias. stage and roster_remove are inverses. With no active Novel, create writes the roster (profile-only unless `ruleset` is named); an explicit `context` wins over an active Novel. Use when: creating, importing, staging, activating, or editing a PC, or handling player feedback. Do NOT use when: managing an NPC — use manage_npc.

action.description: create, stage, import, sheet, set_active, personality, voice, signal, update, remove, roster_remove, or roster_list.

context.description: Which store to act on: novel, codex, roster, or reference. Explicit wins over the active Novel; with no value, an open Novel answers novel-capable actions and a create with no Novel goes to the roster.

examples.description: Voice examples (voice); at most 5; source tags synthesis examples for the [supplementary] annotation.

name.description: Character name; omit (create) to begin step-by-step while a Novel is active.

ruleset.description: Installed ruleset slug for a create with no active Novel (profile-only when omitted and several are installed).

signal.description: Feedback category (signal); detail carries terse|normal|rich; register carries character|meta.

spells.description: Known spells (update); entries may be bare names or {name, level} objects.

stats.description: Mechanical stat keys to shallow-merge into the entity's stats (update).

name: manage_character

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or ERROR; an error's Appendix O.2 category rides in `category` (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Player Character Management (create/import, sheet, update)
